approaches.title: Sort and split into halves
approaches.summary: Square the values, sort them, then subtract the sum of the smaller half from the sum of the larger half. Revision 1 pairs from the ends of a descending sort; revision 2 simplifies this to an ascending sort and split.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Sort squared values descending and add/subtract matching values from opposite ends, including the middle square when the count is odd.
Simplify the calculation by sorting ascending, splitting at the midpoint, and subtracting the lower-half sum from the upper-half sum.

approaches.title: Select the midpoint without sorting
approaches.summary: Use an nth-element selection to partition values by absolute magnitude, then subtract the smaller-side squared sum from the larger-side squared sum and include the midpoint square.

revisions.commitBody:
- quickselect has avg O(n) performance but worst case O(n^2)
- introselect is a variant that brings the worst case down to O(nlogn)
revisions.shortChangeSummary: Replace full sorting with `select_nth_unstable_by_key` to partition around the median magnitude before calculating the sum.
